reviews.title: Love it
reviews.comment: I really enjoy the Logitech G325 LIGHTSPEED headset. It’s lightweight and extremely comfortable, even during long gaming sessions. The Lightspeed wireless connection is fast and stable, with almost no lag, making gameplay smooth and immersive. The battery life is excellent, lasting through multiple sessions without needing a recharge. Sound quality is clear and accurate for games and videos, though the bass could be slightly deeper. The built-in microphone works fine for chat, but isn’t as strong as a dedicated boom mic. Overall, this headset offers excellent performance and comfort at a budget-friendly price, and I highly recommend it for gamers who want quality without spending a fortune.
reviews.author: Nino Nadiradze

reviews.title: Over delivered!
reviews.comment: I’ve gone through my fair share of gaming headsets over the years, and the Logitech G325 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset genuinely stands out as one of the best values I’ve used. First off, the comfort is exceptional. It’s incredibly lightweight—almost to the point where you forget you’re wearing it—and the dual-layer foam ear cushions make long gaming sessions effortless. Whether I’m gaming for hours or just using it casually, there’s zero fatigue.  ￼ The sound quality punches well above its price range. The 24-bit audio delivers crisp highs, solid mids, and surprisingly immersive depth for a headset in this range. Everything from footsteps in competitive games to music and videos sounds clean and detailed.  ￼ One of my favorite features is the built-in beamforming microphone. Not having a bulky boom arm gives it a sleek, modern look, and the voice clarity is excellent—especially with the added AI noise reduction. It’s perfect for gaming, Discord, or even work calls.  ￼ Pair that with 20+ hours of battery life, and you’ve got a headset that easily keeps up with your day.  ￼ What really impressed me most is how much Logitech packed into this headset at around the $80 price point. It feels like a premium product without the premium cost—great design, reliable performance, and excellent all-around usability. Bottom line: If you want a wireless headset that nails comfort, sound, and versatility without breaking the bank, the G325 is an easy recommendation. It’s one of those rare products that actually overdelivers.
reviews.author: Jared Greenleaf

reviews.title: Clear sound
reviews.comment: Great headset for the price. Very comfortable — I can wear it all day without any discomfort. The sound is clear and immersive, perfect for both gaming and music. The microphone picks up my voice well with minimal background noise. Battery life is solid and lasts a long time. Easy to connect to different devices. Very happy with this purchase 👍
reviews.author: Anastasiia

reviews.title: It’s about perfect
reviews.comment: I don’t know much else to say besides I love this headset.  I have had so many and this one is tops for me. - Comfortable enough for hours of listening - Connects to everything Bluetooth (except PS5, boo Sony) - The lightspeed connector for PC/PS5 is great, plug and play - Mute button for the mic is convenient - I have yet to charge it and had it for 5 days, used a couple hours each day, and it was 50% when I got it - USB C charging - Great audio - Quailty padding on the ears and headband - Super light! Only con is not having a case, but at this price, I didn’t expect it.  It doesn’t drop signal, audio quality is nice.  I just love it.
reviews.author: Cody A.

reviews.title: A really comfortable and affordable gaming headset
reviews.comment: What I like the most is how light and comfortable they are. They connect super fast too. I literally opened the box, connected the dongle to my PC, turned them on, and it just connected instantly. The only flaws is that the mic isn’t the best but it’s perfectly usable. The sound quality is your pretty average bassy gamey sound profile so if you dig that kind of sound from other gaming headsets you’ll probably like this one too.
